method: Exact BigDecimal comparison against visible print. OCR uses its editor; Paddle uses the actual hybrid only where the production router would request a reliable crop; complete OCR, no crop and failures retain baseline; Gemma crop/full rows score standalone JSON. The separate gemma4-e2b-macros row replays those exact native responses through the production missing-macro consumer; energy, name, mass and existing OCR fields cannot change. Correct OCR fields removed by a candidate also prevent recommendation.
